entries.zh: 把罪犯烹死（以沸煮或火烧处死）
entries.en: to put a criminal to death by boiling or burning
entries.notes: L「oficial」费解（或指公开行刑），H、M 均作「烹死」，义从之。

entries.en: to cook meat (by boiling or roasting)
to grill on a gridiron; to bake over fire

entries.zh: 用火把人焙死（如圣老楞佐受火刑）
entries.en: to roast a person to death over a fire (as St. Lawrence was martyred)
to roast; to prepare (food) by fire
entries.notes: H 仅「炮」一字，L「asar el recado」费解，暂取以火烹制之义。

entries.en: gunner; master gunner
entries.notes: H「炮手頭」明指炮手头目，L「asar cañones」与 H 不合，疑为「asestar cañones」（瞄准火炮）之讹。

entries.en: to scorch; to roast until burnt
entries.notes: L「asar hostar」疑为「asar hasta (quemar)」之讹，与 H「炮燒」相合。

entries.en: to warm oneself at a fire; to roast at a fire (of a beggar begging fire)
entries.notes: L「asar ael hombre」与 H「乞人討火焙」语义不合，H、M 明指乞人讨火取暖。

entries.zh: 腹侧，胁腹（供烤食的部位）
entries.en: the flank (side of the belly), a cut for roasting
entries.notes: L「Asa.」为缩写，H 次字「胼」存疑（疑为「旁/膀」），义仅据「腹」推为腹侧肉。

entries.en: red-hot; roasted red by fire
glowing charcoal; live coals
entries.notes: L 作「acqua」（水），与 H「燒炭紅」不合，疑为 ascua/brasa 之误，义从 H。

entries.en: live coal; ember
to watch for; to lie in wait for
entries.notes: 单字「張」在此取张望守候义以合 asechar，L 后半「hari」残损难读。

entries.en: to peer out; to keep watch
entries.notes: H 次字存疑（眉/鬼），L「penganas ha tenptera」残损，仅据「張」定张望窥伺义。

entries.en: to be on the alert; to take care
entries.notes: L「asechar; estira alerta」中「alerta」与 H「張持」（警戒）相应，L 前半残损。

entries.en: to spread a net; to lay an ambush
entries.notes: L「mirar de ref.r」残损，H「張網」与 asechar（埋伏）相合。

entries.en: to spy on; to peep at
to peep; to peek
to peep and see; to glimpse
to lean out; to poke forward (cautiously)
entries.notes: L「Apechar」疑为「asomar/apechugar（探出、挺身）」之讹，与 H「闖」相合。

entries.en: to poke one's head out of the window (to look)
to inquire; to inform oneself (about)
